intent: Show a short line of metadata above a message's surface, such as the sender's name.
typical_uses: The sender's name above the bubble
A sender's name together with the time the message was sent

dont_use_when.situation: Text that is part of the message itself

invariants.text: The header is a flex row that centers its children vertically, is inset var(--space-3) on the inline sides and renders in the meta text size at the label weight in var(--muted-foreground).
Under `align="end"` on the row the header, as a direct child of MessageContent, is aligned to the end edge like the surface below it.
When anything in the row carries `data-variant="ghost"` (a Bubble with `variant="ghost"` stamps it), the header's inline inset drops to zero so it sits flush with the frameless surface.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the sender's name inside the Bubble
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put it in a MessageHeader above the Bubble, where it takes the muted meta style

good.title: A sender name above the surface

bad.title: The sender name written into the bubble
bad.why: The name becomes part of the message text, in the body style and inside the surface; MessageHeader sets it apart above the bubble in the muted meta style.
